name: 34420 · Belleview, FL
findings: ZIP 34420 (Belleview) has 42 nonprofit organizations. 12 of them (29%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 34420 (Belleview) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
